dedupe_keys.name: coastal flood hazard dataset extreme water levels and sea level rise projections for izmir province criz ers

description: A CLIMAAX coastal-flood workflow deposit for İzmir Province, Türkiye, provides input maps, modelled extreme-water-level layers and a Jupyter notebook. Zenodo lists two public ZIPs and the notebook under CC BY 4.0. The description identifies a digital elevation model, land cover, water-surface-level rasters for 5, 10, 50 and 100-year events, and static inundation maps. It says the levels combine Copernicus reanalysis and statistical data with IPCC AR6 sea-level-rise projections. These inputs can support coastal exposure scenarios for roads, substations or hospitals, and the notebook documents how the producer generated the layers. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this İzmir release. A limitation is that static inundation does not represent hydrodynamic timing, wave action or defence failure. The page does not give grid resolution, vertical datum or validation against observed coastal floods. Files named inside the ZIPs were reported by the provider but were not independently inventoried. No archive was downloaded and the notebook was not executed.
